concerns.text: The permutation change‑point test (FR‑004) models per‑hop accuracy with a simple linear regression (RSS reduction) despite accuracy being a proportion bounded in [0,1]. Linear regression assumes normally distributed, homoscedastic residuals, which is violated for binomial outcomes. A more appropriate model (e.g., logistic regression or a binomial GLM) should be used for the null and alternative models to ensure valid inference.
